mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the past month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through joint momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply constraints (INDPRO < 105.0), a decline in industrial production signals weakening economic activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) serve as a leading indicator of economic expansion that boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without conditional triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals accelerating inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a tightening labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through joint dynamics.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), rate hikes increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
